available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling

region.description: Location where the component applies. Can be a zone or node.

operation_costs.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for a technology. Units: USD/MWh

min_discharge_fraction.description: Minimum discharge as a fraction of total discharge capacity. Units: 1

capital_costs_energy.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. Units: USD/MWh

capital_costs_charge.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. Units: USD/MW

capital_costs_discharge.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. Units: USD/MW

unit_size_discharge.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Size of each unit of discharging capacity being built. Units: MW

unit_size_charge.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Unit size of charging capacity. Units: MW

unit_size_energy.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Size of each unit being built. Units: MWh

capacity_limits_charge.description: allowable installed power capacity for a storage technology. Units: MW

capacity_limits_discharge.description: allowable installed power capacity for a storage technology. Units: MW

capacity_limits_energy.description: allowable installed energy capacity for a storage technology. Units: MWh

duration_limits.description: Minimum and maximum duration limits (energy to discharge capacity ratio) for a storage technology (hours). Units: h

efficiency.description: Efficiency of charging storage, fraction of total charge (in) and discharge (out) capacity. Units: 1

losses.description: Self-discharge of storage (fraction of energy stored per hour). Units: 1/h

lifetime.description: Maximum number of years a technology can be active once installed (years). Units: yr

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology
